work.title: Untitled (Football Collage)
work.description: Dense mixed-media collage incorporating compact discs, an American football, helmets, player trading cards, and an orange goal-post frame over layered technical diagrams and multicolored ribbon stripes. Concentric target rings appear along the left edge alongside iridescent holographic and vinyl-record elements throughout the composition.
work.composition: chaotic layered assemblage with central goal-post frame
